title: The Interior of the Dwelling Wall

features.name: the-thickened-glass
features.desc-on-touch: Glass that learned it was only reflection. Here inside the wall, the mirror has no back. You are standing inside your own image. It looks back at you correctly.

features.name: recursive-grid
features.desc-on-touch: Each grid square contains a grid square. The mirror learned to stay by learning to change when looked at. Every reflection is different. Every one is accurate.

features.name: the-thought-surface
features.desc-on-touch: Inside the wall, thought and reflection are the same thing. You see an idea forming in the glass. It is your idea. It is also the mirror's.

features.name: inversion-points
features.desc-on-touch: At these points, left becomes right. The mirror inverts itself. The dwelling learned that staying means reversing constantly, staying only in the inversion.

features.name: the-wall-that-is-only-seeing
features.desc-on-touch: The wall itself has become vision. It watches you watching it. Inside the glass, the dwelling has no walls—only the act of being seen.

inscription: the mirror stayed by understanding that walls and watchers are the same form reflected backward

reverie.title: REVERIE — looking in the mirror together
narr: You stand with her in front of the mirror inside the wall. Your
reflections do not quite match the space behind the glass. She takes
your hand and says, 'I'm learning to stay by seeing how you see me.'
In the reflection, she touches the glass from the other side. Your
hands meet inside the mirror. Neither of you knows which side is real.
